deviations.why: Sibling tools (rsu-withholding-gap-calculator, freelancer-tax-pack) treat $0 prior-year tax as 'not entered', the same as defect 1, but that errs toward overpaying, not toward a penalty, and fixing it needs a blank-vs-zero distinction in their UIs.

real_defects.issue: 110% safe harbor keyed on this year's AGI; IRC 6654(d)(1)(C) uses last year's. Income falling from 200k to 93k was told 100% of last year's tax suffices (10% short, penalty). Fixed: optional priorYearAgi input; blank falls back to this year's AGI and the finding says so. Test: '110% safe harbor keys on last year's AGI'.

priorYearTax 0 still told the user the IRS expects 1040-ES payments; Pub. 505: no penalty when last year's 12-month return showed no tax (citizen/resident all year). Fixed: info finding instead. Test: 'zero tax last year means no underpayment penalty'.
'Taxable income is above the $201,750 line' finding fired whenever qbi was 0 and net>0, including taxable income 0 (revenue 5000). Fixed: also require taxable > QBI_LIMIT.

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
